text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, this should do it. Next up is the 
kitchen, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Whoa, the table's sparkling clean. Did 
Buena-chan do this?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm helping out today. The lady 
seemed to be having a tough time.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Buena-chan. My frozen 
shoulder has been killing me lately. 
You're a real lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, the rice cooker is completely 
empty... Hey ma'am, do you think I could 
get a refill~?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Coming right up! ...Phew. Everyone's got a 
great appetite as always. Better serve 
this up quick—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll bring the rice cooker! I'll cook 
up some fresh rice too.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true!? Sorry for the trouble, 
that really helps!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Thanks, Buena-chan. I'll gladly take 
some.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you all out of the grilled 
mackerel set? Well then, what should I get 
instead...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I can prepare it! I've 
already restocked the missing ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it quickly together with the 
lady here. Please wait just a little bit 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! Sorry about that, Buena-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Now that the dishes are done, 
next is...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on! Take a break already, you've 
been working non-stop this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. Still, I want 
to help as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to help everyone in the 
cafeteria someday... That's what I was 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: ...Phew! Alright then, one last push!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you mind if I borrow the 
kitchen for a bit— Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! There's so much food... Do you 
really make this much every single day?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, pretty much. I just want everyone 
to eat their fill.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be awful if people didn't get 
enough to eat? We've gotta put our hearts 
into making this!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The food from this cafeteria that they 
make for us every day... is filled with 
warmth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to be of help. ...For the sake of 
everyone in the kindhearted cafeteria 
staff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, seriously...?! Isn't Buena-chan 
being super generous!?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I eat a ton of them 
too. The hamburg steak plate here. ...I 
get super huge second helpings and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright! Guess I'll get to it too! 
Gonna wash the dishes for now!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Are you sure about this, 
Jordan-san?

Hehe, so that's what's going on. Well, I 
can't just leave you hanging then~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Getting to eat our fill is all thanks to 
the ladies, after all~ Helping out once in 
a while is the least we can do, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll whip something up too. You're always 
feeding me warm, delicious meals, after 
all. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even Tran-san and Acute-san...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Haha, who knew it would get so lively. 
...Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! To think you'd help out this 
much...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I need to be more helpful too! 
Oh, I know, I'll peel the vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're still working!? You gotta 
take a break already!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously though... That's just the kind 
of thing you'd do, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy was buzzing with rumors. 
Word had spread that Buena Vista and the 
others had been a massive help to the dorm 
staff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, pretty much~. Or rather, shouldn't 
you be praising Buena-chan more~?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... I just wanted to be of some 
help, that's all.
choice_data_list: I'm glad everyone lent a helping hand.
I'm sure the staff are delighted too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. ...Thank you so much for your 
help back then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it. We only did it 
because we wanted to."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Even so, I still really want to 
say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Is that so. Well, fine by me. Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The cafeteria staff said 
they wanted to thank us too—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Today's set meal looks even more 
extravagant than usual! Hehe... I must eat 
it with even more gratitude than always."
